title: The Seed That Whispered
summary: Pip Applebrook, a nap-loving apple-headed homebody, is handed a whispering golden ring by the wizard Perriwick. It is the stolen heart of Malgrath the Charred King, it cannot stay in Greenhollow, and Pip — with Tango and his pans — must carry it far from home. In distant Cinderpith, a molten eye opens.
synopsis: Episode 1: A small fruit-headed traveller receives a mysterious ring-shaped magical object and learns that it must be taken far from home.
hook: This apple is about to ruin his whole life.

beats.summary: Flash-forward: Pip trembles over the glowing Everseed in the rain.
beats.narration: This apple is about to ruin his whole life.

beats.summary: Greenhollow at golden hour; Pip naps and refuses all adventure.
beats.narration: In Greenhollow, the most dangerous thing was a bad harvest. And Pip Applebrook lived by one rule: never have an adventure.

beats.summary: Stormy night: Perriwick arrives and presses the golden seed-ring into Pip's hands.
beats.narration: Then, one stormy night, the wizard Perriwick arrived... carrying a golden ring grown from a single seed.

dialogue.line: Keep it hidden. And never let it ripen.

beats.summary: Pip hides the ring by baking it into a pie; the pie starts to whisper.
beats.narration: So Pip did what any sensible fruit would do. He baked it into a pie. The pie began to whisper.

beats.summary: Perriwick's staff reveals Malgrath: the Everseed is his stolen heart.
beats.narration: Because the Everseed was the stolen heart of Malgrath, the Charred King. And the king wanted it back.

beats.summary: Dawn: Pip leaves Greenhollow; Tango bursts in with his pans to come along.
beats.narration: It could not stay in Greenhollow. It had to go far from home.

dialogue.line: If you're going, I'm going. I packed pans.

beats.summary: In Cinderpith a molten eye opens and senses them.
beats.narration: Far away, in the ash of Cinderpith, a molten eye opened... and smelled apple.

scenes.description: Flash-forward hook: Pip in the rain, staring at the glowing Everseed in his trembling palm.
scenes.action: Pip stares down at the glowing golden Everseed ring resting in his trembling palm as rain streaks down his apple skin
scenes.subject_motion: raindrops run down the apple skin, his eyes widen and his stem leaf droops, his hand trembles around the glowing ring
scenes.environment: a rain-soaked garden path in Greenhollow at night, blurred lanterns behind
scenes.environment_motion: heavy rain falls in streaks, lantern bokeh flickers, golden light pulses from the ring
scenes.lighting: golden under-light from the ring on the face, cold blue rain rim light, dark background
scenes.facial_expression: eyes wide with dread, brow ridges pinched upward, mouth slightly open
scenes.narration: This apple is about to ruin his whole life.
scenes.sound_design: rain, low hit on the first word, magic hum from the ring

scenes.description: Establishing Greenhollow: gourd houses, orchards, golden hour.
scenes.action: tiny Pip dozes in a hammock strung between two orchard trees outside his gourd house
scenes.subject_motion: the hammock sways gently while Pip sleeps, one boot dangling
scenes.environment: the rolling hills of Greenhollow with giant hollowed gourd houses, smoking chimneys, orchards and vegetable gardens
scenes.environment_motion: chimney smoke curls, dandelion seeds drift, orchard leaves ripple in a warm breeze
scenes.lighting: warm golden-hour sunlight, soft haze, long gentle shadows
scenes.narration: In Greenhollow, the most dangerous thing was a bad harvest.

scenes.description: Pip in his hammock refuses a butterfly-carried leaflet about adventure.
scenes.action: Pip swats away a curious butterfly without opening his eyes and pulls his moss-green hood down over his face
scenes.subject_motion: a lazy swat of the hand, the hood tugged down, a satisfied wiggle back into the hammock
scenes.environment: hammock between orchard trees, a pie cooling on a nearby windowsill of the gourd house
scenes.environment_motion: the butterfly flutters away, steam rises from the pie, leaves sway
scenes.facial_expression: eyes closed, smug little smile, stem leaf perked up
scenes.narration: And Pip Applebrook lived by one rule: never have an adventure.
scenes.sound_design: birds, soft whoosh on the swat

scenes.description: Stormy night: Perriwick looms in Pip's round doorway, staff glowing.
scenes.action: the round gourd door swings open to reveal the tall pear-headed wizard dripping with rain, amber staff blazing, while tiny Pip peeks from behind the door
scenes.subject_motion: the wizard steps over the threshold, cloak whipping in the wind; Pip clutches the door edge
scenes.environment: the round doorway of Pip's gourd house at night in a thunderstorm
scenes.environment_motion: rain lashes sideways, lightning flashes, the lantern swings wildly
scenes.lighting: lightning flashes, amber glow from the staff crystal, warm hearth light from inside
scenes.facial_expression: the wizard's deep-set eyes grave under bushy brows; Pip's eyes wide and startled
scenes.narration: Then, one stormy night, the wizard Perriwick arrived... carrying a golden ring grown from a single seed.
scenes.sound_design: thunder, rain, door creak, magic shimmer

scenes.description: Perriwick presses the Everseed into Pip's hands.
scenes.action: over Pip's shoulder, the wizard kneels and closes Pip's small hands around the glowing golden ring
scenes.subject_motion: the wizard leans down slowly and folds Pip's fingers over the ring; his beard sways as he speaks
scenes.environment: inside Pip's cosy round gourd kitchen, fire crackling in a hearth
scenes.environment_motion: fire flickers, the ring's glow leaks between Pip's fingers, dust motes float
scenes.lighting: warm hearth firelight, golden glow from the ring under the wizard's face
scenes.facial_expression: the wizard's grave, kind eyes; mouth moving in the beard as he speaks

dialogue.line: Keep it hidden. And never let it ripen.

scenes.sound_design: fire crackle, ring hum, low drone

scenes.description: Pip bakes the ring into a pie. The pie glows and whispers.
scenes.action: Pip nervously pushes the ring into a fresh pie, covers it with pastry, then leans back as the pie begins to glow and its crust breathes like it is whispering
scenes.subject_motion: hands press the ring into the pie, then Pip freezes and slowly leans away
scenes.environment: Pip's cluttered round kitchen with copper pans, jars of jam and flour everywhere
scenes.environment_motion: flour dust hangs in the air, golden light pulses through cracks in the pie crust, steam curls
scenes.lighting: warm kitchen candlelight with pulsing golden glow from the pie
scenes.facial_expression: forced innocent smile turning into horrified wide eyes, stem leaf standing straight up
scenes.narration: So Pip did what any sensible fruit would do. He baked it into a pie. The pie began to whisper.
scenes.sound_design: whispering magic, comedic hit when the pie glows, whoosh out

scenes.description: A vision in the staff's light: Malgrath on his throne in Cinderpith.
scenes.action: in a fiery vision, the towering charred dark lord rises from a throne of black glass at the top of the bramble tower
scenes.subject_motion: the dark lord slowly stands, smoke pouring from his shoulders, ember cracks brightening
scenes.environment: the charred bramble tower of Mount Cinderpith above rivers of lava under a blood-red sky
scenes.environment_motion: embers rain upward, lava churns below, smoke rolls across the sky
scenes.lighting: infernal orange underlighting from lava, red sky, hard silhouette
scenes.facial_expression: the single molten slit eye narrows and flares
scenes.narration: Because the Everseed was the stolen heart of Malgrath, the Charred King. And the king wanted it back.
scenes.sound_design: deep rumble, fire ambience, creature growl, dramatic hit on 'wanted it back'

scenes.description: Dawn: Pip at Greenhollow's gate, satchel packed, looking at the long road.
scenes.action: Pip walks toward camera down the lane out of Greenhollow, satchel on his shoulder, clutching the ring through his cloak
scenes.subject_motion: small determined steps, one nervous glance back over his shoulder
scenes.environment: a dirt lane at the edge of Greenhollow at dawn, the last gourd houses behind him
scenes.environment_motion: morning mist rolls across the fields, birds take off, the grass sways
scenes.lighting: cool dawn light with a warm sunrise rim on the apple skin
scenes.facial_expression: jaw set, eyes brave but glassy, stem leaf lifted
scenes.narration: It could not stay in Greenhollow. It had to go far from home.
scenes.sound_design: footsteps on dirt, dawn birds, music swell

scenes.description: Tango crashes through the hedge with his pans to join Pip.
scenes.action: Tango bursts out of the hedge in a shower of leaves, pots clanging on his giant backpack, and plants himself beside Pip
scenes.subject_motion: Tango tumbles out, straightens up proudly and adjusts his scarf; Pip stares, then smiles
scenes.environment: a flowering hedge beside the dawn lane
scenes.environment_motion: leaves and petals scatter, pots swing and clank
scenes.facial_expression: Tango beaming with determination; Pip's surprise melting into a grateful smile

dialogue.line: If you're going, I'm going. I packed pans.

scenes.sound_design: leaves rustle, pots clank, light comedic hit

scenes.description: Cinderpith: the molten eye snaps open.
scenes.action: extreme close-up of the charred dragon-fruit head as the single molten slit eye snaps open and the ember cracks flare
scenes.subject_motion: the eye opens slowly then dilates, cracks across the charred skin flare brighter
scenes.environment: darkness of the throne room in Mount Cinderpith, embers drifting
scenes.environment_motion: embers drift across frame, smoke curls, heat haze ripples
scenes.lighting: molten gold light from the eye, deep black shadows, orange ember rim light
scenes.facial_expression: the slit eye narrows with hungry recognition
scenes.narration: Far away, in the ash of Cinderpith, a molten eye opened... and smelled apple.
scenes.sound_design: riser, heartbeat, deep hit on the eye opening

cliffhanger: Far away, in the ash of Cinderpith, a molten eye opened... and smelled apple.

Episode 1 of The Everseed Saga — an original, fruit-headed epic fantasy parody.

Pip Applebrook wanted nothing but naps and pie. Then the wizard Perriwick handed him the Everseed: a whispering golden ring grown from a single seed... and the stolen heart of the Charred King.

Next time: the road out of Greenhollow is already being watched.
